summary.title: Daily stand-up summary
summary.intro: With the "Daily stand-up summary" button, opencode prepares yesterday, today and blockers from the entries since the last working day and the day's reminders. It isn't sent anywhere: you copy it yourself.

worklog.title: Log hours in JIRA
worklog.intro: Monday to Thursday 9 hours are logged and on Fridays 6. They are split among the tasks with activity that day. Nothing is written until you press “Log in JIRA”.
worklog.noDays: There are no working days in that range.
worklog.noActivity: No recorded activity: add the task by hand or skip the day.
worklog.confirm: {{count}} work logs ({{hours}} h) will be written to JIRA. Continue?
